items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: So she came in and sat in with us on a couple of songs

ctx.x: Nicki Parrott’s on bass, correct. And she is fabulous. We found her, well I saw her first and told Les, I said, “Les, I heard this female bass player.” He says “aww, she can’t play bass.” I says, “Les, you have to hear her.” So she came in and sat in with us on a couple of songs and he said whoa, he couldn’t believe it. Because he figured it’s a girl—
